references.text: Describes unleavened cakes mixed with oil and unleavened loaves anointed with oil as part of the grain offering regulations, using the same ingredients mentioned in the thank offering.
Continuation of the regulations concerning the thank offering, including leavened bread and rules for when the meat must be eaten.
General instructions on how to offer a thank offering to the Lord properly.
Encouragement to offer a thank offering to God, highlighting the spiritual significance of the thank offering.
Call to bring a thank offering and proclaim the Lord's deeds with joy.
Promise to bring a thank offering and call upon the name of the Lord, expressing gratitude to God.
Prophecy that people will come bringing thank offerings to the house of the Lord.
Ironical reference to Israel's love for bringing thank offerings, showing the significance of sacrifice in Israelite worship.
Call to bring an offering of praise as a fruit of lips that confess God's name, the spiritual fulfillment of the thank offering in the New Testament.
